q: The Collatz map C(n) = n/2 (n even) or (3n+1)/2 (n odd), viewed as a map on the 2-adic integers ℤ₂ with Haar measure, is:
exp: Terras–Lagarias: the accelerated Collatz map C̃: ℤ₂→ℤ₂ is measure-preserving and ergodic with respect to Haar measure. Ergodicity on ℤ₂ means almost all 2-adic integers have orbits that are equidistributed in ℤ₂ — supporting the conjecture heuristically.
